meta.home.description: A static documentation site: Markdown/MDX content, a generated sidebar, prev/next links and per-page tables of contents. No backend.

doc.missing.title: This page does not exist yet
doc.missing.body: No content file maps to this route. Add a Markdown or MDX file under src/content/docs and it appears here automatically.
home.hero.title: Docs your readers can navigate.
home.hero.description: Write Markdown or MDX under src/content/docs; the sidebar, prev/next links and page tables of contents derive from the content tree. Declared pages prerender to static HTML and hydrate — no backend required.
home.sections.title: Browse the documentation
home.section.fallback: Pages generated from the content tree.
home.features.title: How this template works
home.features.routing.title: File-based routing
home.features.routing.body: Every file under src/content/docs becomes a page at a file-derived route. Drop a new file in and the sidebar and links follow — no React edit needed.
home.features.frontmatter.title: Frontmatter metadata
home.features.frontmatter.body: A small YAML block sets each page's title, description and reading order. The parser is pure JS and fail-soft: content never crashes the site.
home.features.prerender.title: Prerendered and hydrated
home.features.prerender.body: Declared routes build to static HTML with real content and metadata, then hydrate the same React tree in the browser (D-202).
notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.body: The path you followed matches no page in this site. The documentation home is a good place to restart.
